retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central figure amidst dynamic, floating objects and vibrant pink liquid splatters against a neutral industrial background.
triggerTerms: pink paint splatter on white brick

recipe.visualDefinition: A central musician figure in a wide stance holding a guitar, surrounded by motion-blurred pink tomatoes and vertical pink paint drips on a white brick wall, grounded by a dark wet floor with smashed debris.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored between floating foreground and background elements
Vibrant pink accents contrasting against a monochrome black, white, and grey base
Vertical paint drips echoing the verticality of the central figure
Motion blur on peripheral objects creating a sense of chaotic action
coreInvariants: Vibrant pink liquid splatter and drips
High-contrast lighting with deep blacks and bright whites

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, medium-long shot, occupying the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark matte guitar held at the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion from the blurred foreground tomatoes leading inward to the central figure, then upward to the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced white brick wall space in the upper quadrants to allow for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background wall) and Black (clothing and floor)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink elements against a desaturated, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to Black, White, Grey, and a single shade of vibrant Pink

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and stencil-style block lettering
letterConstructionRules: Integration of graphic symbols (like an 'A' in a circle) into letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters replaced or overlaid with punk-style iconography
Text contained within rectangular 'tape' or 'sticker' blocks with rough edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display text paired with a secondary 'stamped' or 'taped' sub-header.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical compression and heavy weight.
Captures the raw, industrial punk aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with pink hair in a white t-shirt and black jeans stands in a wide stance holding a black guitar against a white brick wall. Vibrant pink paint is splattered on the wall and floor. Several pink tomatoes are frozen in mid-air with motion blur.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, distressed black and pink block typography in the top right corner, using a stencil-like effect for the secondary line.

verificationChecks: Is the pink color consistent across hair, splatter, and fruit?
Does the typography look distressed and integrated into the scene?
Is there a clear sense of depth between the blurred foreground and sharp background?

adjustableVariables: Amount of motion blur on floating objects
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the pink is a vibrant magenta, not a soft pastel.
Ensure the brick wall texture is visible through the paint drips.
Verify the typography has a 'stamped' or 'stencil' quality.
Confirm the floor has a reflective, wet appearance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait with a limited palette (B&W + 1 neon color), dynamic floating debris, and distressed block typography.
